data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release on prior year claims (net release of GBP 8.2m) but did note adverse prior year development in certain areas, notably an GBP 8.5m deterioration on New Zealand earthquake claims. Current year catastrophe and large losses (Nebraska tornados, UK storms, European hailstorms) and aviation war account losses (including two Malaysian Airlines hull losses and Tripoli Airport attacks) also materially affected the 2014 claims experience. The report does not disclose an aggregate GROSS prior year movement for claims outstanding (only net figures), so an authoritative gross PYD is not available from the published notes.

data.data_quality_notes: The report discloses only NET prior year reserve movements (a net release of GBP 8.2m). No explicit aggregate GROSS prior year movement for claims outstanding is provided in the available notes. A gross PYD could not be determined from the published notes or a claims development triangle (no triangle present). As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Some event amounts quoted in the narrative appear to be net losses to the syndicate (used above) but in several instances the report does not explicitly state whether figures are gross or net; confidence levels are provided accordingly.
